header_summary:
At the Gordian Developers Meeting hosted by Blockchain Commons, advanced Bitcoin security techniques will be discussed, including exporting descriptors and extended private keys from Bitcoin Core, as well as utilizing Shamir's Secret Sharing. Shannon Appelcline and Stan Reeves will lead presentations on integrating Bitcoin Core with resilience features and on the Keylay protocol for secure multisig setup, respectively. Interested participants can join the session via Zoom using this [link](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88143195571?pwd=rgVeDCgOKT3IMtBiISego4p5wK0s6F.1). More details can be found [here](https://gnusha.org/pi/bitcoindev/c02e2f36-0e87-4968-8700-6b5a648a9397n@googlegroups.com/T/#u#me1ea892f8a00344a7641e457b12c146429db40d0).

The `staletip` initiative, developed to enhance the observability of stale rates within the Bitcoin network and based on AJ Towns' foundational work, introduces a peer-to-peer messaging system for sharing information about stale tips. This system, which aims to improve diagnostics and response times in reorganization handling, is detailed in a [Draft BIP](https://github.com/pseudoramdom/bips/blob/staletip-bip-draft/bip-staletip.md) and a [Proof-of-concept](https://github.com/w0xlt/bitcoin/tree/staletip-v4) developed by pseudoramdom and w0xlt. Further information is available [here](https://gnusha.org/pi/bitcoindev/d92f1615-368b-4406-b326-a1799c72a555n@googlegroups.com/T/#u#m41b778c563618967693cc6dce70328d7cb7151db).

In the context of network operations, particularly Opportunity Management (OM), nodes are empowered to assess reputations of both channel and non-channel peers, influencing resource allocation and transaction rates. This nuanced framework underlines the importance of reputation in network efficiency and the potential trade-offs between coarser and more granular accounting methods in response to adversarial activities, as detailed [here](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/onion-message-jamming-in-the-lightning-network/2414/23). 

The discussion on incorporating Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into systems like Bitcoin emphasizes proactive implementation to prepare for potential quantum computing advancements. Scott Aaronson advocates for immediate integration of PQC, critiquing the analogy of quantum computers to explosive devices and suggesting a more controlled, reactor-like approach to their development. Further insights into this discussion can be found [here](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/pqc-output-type-discussion/2749/4).

recent_posts.title: Bitcoin Resilience Presentations — August 5
recent_posts.summary: - On August 5th, Blockchain Commons will host a Gordian Developers Meeting.  - The session will enhance Bitcoin Core integration and asset security.  - Presentations will discuss advanced Bitcoin security techniques and key management.

recent_posts.title: [BIP Proposal] Stale Tip Relay
recent_posts.summary:
- The `staletip` proposal enhances Bitcoin network observability by sharing stale rate data.
- It introduces optional P2P messaging for nodes to exchange information on stale blocks.
- This initiative stems from AJ Towns' work and includes a draft and proof-of-concept for review.

recent_posts.title: The game-theory problems of PQ sunsetting modes
recent_posts.summary: - Implementing sunset forks in cryptocurrency poses significant challenges due to CQRCs.  - Miners may halt efforts on authentic chains to mine revisionist ones for greater payoff.  - Periodic checkpoints secured by PQ-safe public keys could mitigate blockchain reorganization risks.

recent_posts.title: Onion Message Jamming in the Lightning Network
recent_posts.summary:
- Nodes differentiate channel peers with higher reputations, impacting resource allocation.
- OM scores, influenced by various factors, shouldn't dominate payment decision processes.
- Hybrid accounting methods balance simplicity with responsiveness to security threats.

recent_posts.title: Onion Messaging DoS Threat Mitigations
recent_posts.summary:
- Implementing a hop-limit may improve network efficiency by using high-capacity nodes.
- Recent integration of `option_onion_messages_only_channels` updates node communication protocols.
- Further research is needed on node willingness to relay Onion Messages without direct channels.

recent_posts.title: PQC output type discussion
recent_posts.summary: - Scott Aaronson advocates for immediate integration of Post-Quantum Cryptography in systems.  - He emphasizes proactive measures over reactive responses to quantum computing advancements.  - Quantum computers are compared to fission reactors, needing controlled and stable environments.

active_posts.title: BIP draft: CISA for Taproot Key Path Spends
active_posts.summary:
- A new Bitcoin Improvement Proposal introduces advanced signature aggregation in transactions.
- Detailed specifications are outlined in BIP 458 and 459, maintaining traditional script path spending.
- The draft and mock pull request for this proposal are available for community feedback and review.

active_posts.title: Quantum Recovery Of Hashed Address Secured Coins With No Confiscatory Risk
active_posts.summary:
- Quantum computing poses risks to cryptocurrency security through ECC vulnerability.
- Proposals like hierarchical proofs and stateful timestamped proofs target post-quantum security.
- Non-hashed addresses lack effective protection against quantum decryption under these methods.

active_posts.title: [BIP Proposal] Informational BIP on Low-R Signature Grinding
active_posts.summary:
- A new Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) formalizes the Low-R signature algorithm.
- The initiative started with Bitcoin Core's PR 1366 and needs standard implementation.
- Feedback on content and test vector sources for this BIP is currently sought.

active_posts.title: [BIP Draft] Segregated Data: a prunable, script-isolated block region for data carriage
active_posts.summary:
- SegData introduces a new Bitcoin block data storage method via a soft-fork, focusing on efficiency.
- It features in-block data commitment through a unique Merkle root, ensuring optional data pruning.
- This system supports reference outputs for data interpreters but not script-evaluated transactions.

active_posts.title: Changes to BIP-360 - Pay to Quantum Resistant Hash (P2QRH)
active_posts.summary: - BIP-360 updates enhance Bitcoin's defense against quantum threats by adopting P2QRH in Taproot.  - It simplifies integration while boosting security against potential long-exposure quantum attacks.  - The strategy also includes planning for Post-Quantum signatures, allowing flexible future enhancements.

active_posts.title: P2share: how to turn any network (or testnet!) into a bitcoin miner
active_posts.summary:
- The p2share network rewards miners with shares, transferring ownership dynamically.
- Rewards are randomly allocated to one shareholder per mined block, simplifying transactions.
- It promotes fairness, efficiency, and trust within a decentralized mining environment.

today_in_history_posts.title: trust
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Thomas Zander debates the trust notion in Bitcoin on the bitcoin-dev mailing list.  - He argues that both trust distribution and decentralization are historically effective.
- Zander warns that misconceptions about Bitcoin could potentially harm many globally.

today_in_history_posts.title: Pure No-Trust Solution using only OP_CLTV
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- The Thunder proposal integrates OP_CLTV and CSV to solve malleability in channel designs.
- Refund processes are simplified by incorporating them into opening transactions, enhancing security.
- A reserve strategy is suggested to address issues with non-revocable HTLCs in the system.

today_in_history_posts.title: Bolt 12 Trusted Contacts
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Bolt 12 enhances lightning wallets with metadata offers and contact management features.
- Two methods for distributing `contact_key` include TLV fields in Bolt 12 offers and BIP21 URIs.
- The aim is refining bLIP 42 for selective identity revelation in payments.
